# Zuhaib Rashid - Projects

This section contains case studies for production applications engineered by Zuhaib Rashid.

- [Flourish UI](https://www.zuhaibrashid.com/projects/flourish-ui) — Premium interactive UI library with 54+ components. [Live library](https://flourish-ui.vercel.app) · [GitHub](https://github.com/Zuhaib-dev/Flourish-UI)
- [Traceora](https://www.zuhaibrashid.com/projects/traceora) — Runtime intelligence and telemetry toolkit used by 4K+ developers per week. [Live demo](https://traceora-web.vercel.app/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/zuhaib-dev/traceora) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@traceora/core)
- [HealOS](https://www.zuhaibrashid.com/projects/healos)
- [Rydexx](https://www.zuhaibrashid.com/projects/rydexx)
- [DealDrop](https://www.zuhaibrashid.com/projects/dealdrop)
- [Repoviz](https://www.zuhaibrashid.com/projects/repoviz)
